en: A monochrome postcard view of a large brick convent complex enclosing a formal garden with flowerbeds, paths, and a low fence in the foreground. The long façade has many evenly spaced windows and dormers set into a steep roof, with small spires and a church section with a cross visible to the right. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene as an English convent and monastery in Bruges, and there is a handwritten note along the upper margin.
